messages.subject: Error: n is null!!!!
parts:
Hi INLA team,

I am getting an error of " Error in inla(formula.4lambdas, family = "poisson", data = LUNGBincid5yrPrds.NOV2020UP_IDs.sort,  :    n is NULL!!!!"   when I am running below code:

formula.4lambdas <- OBS_I ~1+
  f(RegionID, model='besagproper2', graph = H, constr=TRUE)+
  f(RegionID1, model='besagproper2', graph = H, group=TP1, control.group=list(model='iid'))+
  f(RegionID2, model='besagproper2', graph = H, group=TP2, control.group=list(model='iid'))
  f(RegionID3, model='besagproper2', graph = H, group=TP3, control.group=list(model='iid'))
  TP

model.INLA.Lung.ON<-inla(formula.2lambdas, family="poisson", data=LUNGBincid5yrPrds.NOV2020UP_IDs.sort,E=EXP_I,
                         
                         control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE,quantiles = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95)),
                         
                         control.compute=list(dic=TRUE,waic=TRUE,cpo=TRUE),
                         
                         control.inla=list(strategy="simplified.laplace"))

I ran the same code for around 1000 areas successfully, but now when I want to run it for all Ontario including almost 19000 areas, I am getting above error. It is fine if I make the formula shorter only for 2 time periods as below but adding more time periods faced me with above error again.

formula.4lambdas <- OBS_I ~1+
  f(RegionID, model='besagproper2', graph = H, constr=TRUE)+
  f(RegionID1, model='besagproper2', graph = H, group=TP1, control.group=list(model='iid'))

Your help would be most appreciated.
Thanks,
